values.note: One rate for every campsite: $40 a night May 15 - October 31, $50 November 1 - December 31; electricity, dump/fill station, bathhouses and Wi-Fi included. A $5 non-refundable reservation fee on every reservation. A vehicle permit is required for all motor vehicles (day visitors pay $15 per vehicle; the camping page does not say whether campers pay extra).

fees.source: https://www.somersetbeach.org/camping ('CAMPING RATES* May 15 - October 31 $40/night November 1 - Dec. 31st $50/night Jan. 1st - May 14th CLOSED'; '*All reservations have a $5 non-refundable reservation fee'; 'A vehicle permit is required for all motor vehicles'; © 2026) + https://www.somersetbeach.org/pass ('$15 per day/per vehicle'), read 2026-10-22

season.source: https://www.somersetbeach.org/camping (rates May 15 - October 31 and November 1 - Dec. 31st; 'Jan. 1st - May 14th CLOSED'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: 'Electricity at Campsite' (no amperage stated); water from shared spigots and a dump/fill station at the entrance, plus an on-site trailer holding-tank dump service.

hookups.source: https://www.somersetbeach.org/camping ('Campsites include: Electricity at Campsite, Dump/Fill Station at Campground Entrance'; 'On-site Trailer Holding Dump Service') + the 2026 map (water spigots among the sites), read 2026-10-22. The stored 50-amp/water/sewer values came from note prose ('full-hookup options', '15/20/30/50-amp') that the operator's pages do not support, so they are cleared.

values.note: More than 150 electric sites in the North and West camping areas; the 2026 map colours each by trailer capacity: 35, 30 or 25 ft.

sites.source: https://www.somersetbeach.org/camping ('more than 150 electric sites') + the 2026 campground map ('SITE TRAILER CAPACITY: 35' / 30' / 25''), read 2026-10-22. The stored 70-ft maximum and pull-throughs came from note prose and are contradicted / unsupported.

values.note: Modern bathhouses; dump/fill station at the campground entrance; propane refills, firewood, ice, boat and golf-cart rentals.

facilities.source: https://www.somersetbeach.org/camping ('Modern Bathhouses', 'Dump/Fill Station at Campground Entrance', 'Wifi Available', 'Laundry Facilities', 'Propane Tank Refill', 'Boat Rentals', 'Golf Cart Rental') + 2026 map (showers, water spigots, dump station), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Online through the operator's ResNexus page up to 2 years ahead; campers may renew before departure. Full refund 14+ days out, one night's charge within 14 days. Check-in 3pm, RV check-out 1pm.

booking.source: https://www.somersetbeach.org/camping ('Camping reservations may be made online up to 2 years in advance. Campers may renew their reservations before departure'; cancellation policy; 'Check-in is at 3 p.m. ... Check-out is ... 1 p.m. for RV & Tent Camping'), read 2026-10-22

note: Nonprofit Christian campground and retreat center (since 1982) on Somerset Lake near Somerset Center, 226 acres; private swimming beach, boat rentals, trails, zipline, disc golf, youth and family camps. Alcohol, marijuana and fireworks are banned, and a responsible adult must register and stay on site each night. --Claude
summary: Confirmed on the operator's 2026 camping page: ordinary public nightly camping, $40 (May 15 - Oct 31) / $50 (Nov - Dec) with a $5 reservation fee, closed Jan 1 - May 14, 150+ electric sites, bathhouses, laundry, dump/fill, Wi-Fi, online booking 2 years ahead; phone 517-688-3783 matches (Google Maps: 4.7 stars / 125 reviews). Changed max_rig_ft 70 -> 35 (2026 map's site trailer capacities 35/30/25 ft); cleared the note-derived 50-amp, water, sewer and pull-through. Retreat center but camping is sold to the public nightly; no seasonal sites are offered (the 'seasonal pass' is day-visitor access), so not seasonal in character. Note trimmed of the wrong field facts. Base $40 under US$50.
